critique: FAIL: Multiple P0 fatal geometry errors detected. 1. **Title text collision with blue parallelogram**: The title `<text x='640' y='220'>` is visually obscured by the blue parallelogram `<polygon points='540,180 940,180 540,540 140,540'>`. The parallelogram spans y=180 to y=540, directly overlapping with title at y=220. **Fix**: Move title up to `y='160'` or reduce parallelogram height by changing points to `540,280 940,280 540,540 140,540`. 2. **Author list collision with parallelogram**: Author text at `y='300'` is completely covered by the same blue shape. **Fix**: Move author list to `y='360'` (above parallelogram) or `y='560'` (below it). 3. **Affiliation text collision**: Text at `y='340'` also overlaps with parallelogram. **Fix**: Move to `y='390'` or `y='590'`. 4. **Conference text collision**: Text at `y='380'` overlaps with parallelogram. **Fix**: Move to `y='420'` or `y='620'`. 5. **Core Contribution card text overflow**: Last line of card body text at `y='643'` exceeds card boundary (card ends at y=640). **Fix**: Reduce line spacing by changing y values to `538, 568, 598, 628` or increase card height by changing polygon points to `1160,460 600,460 600,660 1160,660`. 6. **Missing separator line visibility**: The separator line at `y='420'` is hidden behind the parallelogram. **Fix**: Move to `y='440'` or remove if redundant.
